admission.justification: Counted loads span the sole generation riser and the exposed counter; typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported.

applicability: Document-load counting on the Operations chat frame.
conditions: Actual document loads increment generation once; responsive late answers do not.
Retry, host return, unanswered-ping recovery and explicit lack of open-agent capability are distinct permitted reload paths.
exclusions: The initial mount is a load, not a reload caused by selection.

evidence: PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx (fallback loads agent URL once in a new element; late ready posts without reload) + data-generation assertions in sidebarChatStaysLoaded.test.tsx

statement: Document loads are counted by generation exactly once at load. They occur for initial mount, explicit Retry/host return, silent ready/open recovery only after unanswered ping, and URL steering when the plugin explicitly lacks open-agent. While a load waits for readiness selections are held; supported ready-channel/late-answer changes do not load.
